literal_meaning: দর (price) + দাম (price); repeated for emphasis on pricing
figurative_meaning_en: The actual or fair price; often implies bargaining or negotiation over value
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে গিয়ে দরদাম না করে কেনা উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: You shouldn't buy anything in the market without bargaining over the price.
This shop allows for some haggling on prices.
note: This is a compound word (yugmashabd) commonly used in Bengali market contexts to denote fair pricing through negotiation.
